title: Natural localization tensor comparison with a fixed K-flat first model
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with a chosen derived category [def-pc-derived-category] and its shared derived tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. Let P be an integer-indexed K-flat complex of module sheaves [def-pc-kflat-complex]. There is a natural isomorphism of functors on all integer-indexed cochain complexes J from J↦Q(P) tensor Q(J) to J↦Q(Tot(P tensor J)) [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. No K-flatness or boundedness assumption on J is imposed.

source.place: Tag 06YH, derived tensor computed using a K-flat first factor

proof.text: Apply the existing K-flat bifunctor natural comparison to the constant singleton family P and the identity family of all cochain complexes. The K-flatness requirement on the first family is hP. Evaluate the resulting natural isomorphism at the unique singleton object. This is the displayed unary natural isomorphism; its second family remains arbitrary.

lean.statement:
theorem kFlat_tensorModel_naturalComparison (X : Scheme.{uX})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wD} (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := X.sheaf) P) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory X.sheaf
    letI := (SheafOfModules.tensorClosed X.sheaf).1.some
    Nonempty
      (DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ (curriedTensor (schemeDerivedCategory X)).obj
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≅
        ((curriedTensor
          (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))).map₂CochainComplex.obj P) ⋙
            DerivedCategory.Q)
